chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Thubayt, from Mu'adh ibn Kathir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: I ask Allah, who granted your father this rank through you, to grant you from your offspring, before death, one like it.
So he said: Allah has already done that.
He said: I said: Who is he, may I be sacrificed for you? So he pointed to the righteous servant while he was lying down, and said: This one who is lying down, and he was a boy.

key_terms.الْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ: the righteous servant, a title used here for Musa عليه السلام
key_terms.الْمَنْزِلَةَ: the rank or station being granted by Allah

ai.seo_question: How did Abu Abdullah عليه السلام indicate the Imamate of Musa عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports Abu Abdullah عليه السلام indicating his successor from among his offspring before his death. He identifies the young Musa عليه السلام by gesturing toward him while he was lying down, showing an explicit designation of the next Imam.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazaz, from Sabeyt, from Muaz Bin Kaseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I ask Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Graced your<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> this status that He<sup>azwj</sup> should Grace you<sup>asws</sup> from your<sup>asws</sup> descendants, before your<sup>asws</sup> passing away, similar to it’.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has already Done that’.

I said, ‘Who is he<sup>asws</sup> (the next Imam<sup>asws</sup>)? May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>!’ So he<sup>asws</sup> gestured towards Al-Abd Al-Salih<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), and he<sup>asws</sup> was lying (sleeping), and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This one<sup>asws</sup> lying down’, and he<sup>asws</sup> was a boy’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people has narrated Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz from Thubayt from that Mu‘dh ibn Kathir who has said the following.

“I said to abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), ‘I pray to Allah who has granted your father because of you such a high position to grant you also such high position through your successor before you will leave this world.”
He then said, “Allah has already granted such favor.”

The narrator has said that he then asked the Imam (a.s.), “Who is he, ‘May Allah take my soul in service for your cause?” He pointed out towards the pious servant (of Allah), who was asleep, saying this man who is asleep.” He was a young boy.”
